text: Artificial intelligence is changing the workplace quickly. Many companies now use automation for repetitive tasks like data entry, so workers can focus on more interesting projects. AI-powered productivity tools help teams organize schedules and answer customer questions faster. Instead of replacing people completely, these systems often support human-AI collaboration, where employees check and improve the machine's work. However, this shift also brings job changes. Some roles may disappear, while new ones appear in areas like AI management and data analysis. To succeed, workers need to learn digital skills and stay flexible. The future of work will likely mix human creativity with smart technology.
